meta.title: Join
meta.description: Join Gamer's Exile. Free forever, no application, every skill level and every platform welcome. Three steps and you're in a squad tonight.

header.title: Three Steps and You're In
header.lead: Free forever. No application, no interview, no skill check. Just a Discord invite and a community that will actually talk to you.

discord.title: Join the Discord
discord.body: One click, no application form and no interview. The invite drops you straight into the welcome channel.

roles.title: Read the rules, pick your roles
roles.body: Two minutes. Choose the games you play and the pings you want, and the right channels appear for you.

intro.title: Say hi in introductions
intro.body: Post a line about what you play. Someone will invite you into a squad the same evening — that part is reliable.

door.title: The Door Is Open
door.body: One click. You'll land in the welcome channel, pick your games, and have somewhere to be tonight.

belonging.title: If You Play Games, You Qualify
belonging.lead: That is the entire entry requirement. Here is what that actually means in practice.

skill.title: Every skill level
skill.body: Bronze to Radiant, first install to five thousand hours. Both ends of that range are in the same voice channels most nights.

platform.title: Every platform
platform.body: PC, console, handheld, mobile. Crossplay lobbies are the norm and nobody gets left out of a squad over hardware.

genre.title: Every genre
genre.body: Competitive shooters and cosy farming sims sit in the same server. Both have dedicated channels and neither gets mocked.

timezone.title: Every timezone
timezone.body: A genuinely global membership means the late-night crowd is somebody else's afternoon. You will find people awake.

rules.title: Short, and Actually Enforced
rules.note: The full list lives in the server. It has never needed to be longer than this.
items: Treat everyone like they're on your team, because eventually they will be.
Trash talk in matches is fine. Personal attacks, slurs and harassment are not.
No self-promo spam outside the creator channels.
Don't gatekeep. Everyone was new once, including you.
If something goes wrong, ping a mod with a clip or a screenshot.
